title: GC full table scan on every run cycle
description: O(N) / UNBOUNDED ALLOCATION — select_gc_candidates (gc_candidates.rs:36) fetches ALL rows from the articles table into a Vec on every GC interval, then evaluates policy in Rust. At 1M articles this materialises ~50–100 MB per run. Fix: push policy evaluation into SQL (age predicate, group wildmat via a precomputed pinned_groups bitmap or a NOT IN subquery) so only actual candidates are transferred, not the full corpus.
